fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 900 S Main St, Fort Worth TX 76104 is the operating Kroger/Vandervoort's dairy plant per Kroger's own manufacturing-division plant address list; satellite shows a dense dairy processing complex (rooftop refrigeration, milk silos) matching the type. Given coords were ~1.1km north of the real building; recentered to the plant core.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Fenced plant core (chain-link + green privacy screen) with pole-mounted security cameras at the fence openings, but no staffed guard booth visible at any entrance street-viewed (2025-01 imagery). Treated as remote check-in (remoteGs).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Urban multi-parcel campus: fenced production block east of the trailer/silo yard, a separate west building, and satellite trailer-storage lots across adjacent streets.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Trailers back into docks on multiple building faces (north and south/west banks).
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Urban Near-Southside block; yard fence and trailers sit directly at the public-street curb with little stacking room outside the gates.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple open trailer-storage lots packed with parked trailers across the campus (50+).
